pr_title: Name the step that sums a receipt

comments.comment: The change gives add, an unexported helper, a TSDoc block, though AGENTS.md says "TSDoc only on exported package API. Nothing on internals."
comments.failureScenario: add is exported neither from src/receipt.ts nor from the package entry, src/index.ts, yet the change documents it with TSDoc. AGENTS.md says "TSDoc only on exported package API. Nothing on internals.", so a contributor reading the file takes add for public API, and the next internal helper copies the block.
